description_en: Queries the host accounts of a host and whether a user is authorized to manage each host account
description_zh: 查询指定用户在指定主机下已授权和未授权的主机账户列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-host-accounts-for-user --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-id 1 --host-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHostAccountsForUser

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host on which you want to perform the query. The host accounts that the specified user is authorized to manage on the specified host are queried.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询已授权主机账户列表的用户所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host on which you want to perform the query. The host accounts that the specified user is authorized to manage on the specified host are queried.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询已授权主机账户列表的用户所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user for which you want to query authorized host accounts.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html operation to query the ID of the user
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询已授权主机账户列表的用户ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to query the ID of the host
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机账户的主机ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.
Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page. We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the host account that you want to query. Exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的主机账户名称。支持精确查询
parameters.name: host_account_name

HostAccounts.description_en: An array that consists of the queried host accounts
HostAccounts.description_zh: 查询到的主机账户列表

HostAccountId.description_en: The ID of the host account

HostAccountName.description_en: The name of the host account

HostId.description_en: The ID of the host for which the host accounts were queried

IsAuthorized.description_en:
Indicates whether the user is authorized to manage the host account. Valid values:

true: yes

false: no
IsAuthorized.description_zh:
主机账户是否授权给当前用户。取值：
true：已授权
false：未授权

ProtocolName.description_en:
The protocol that is used by the host. Valid values:

SSH

RDP
ProtocolName.description_zh:
主机账户的协议名称。取值：
SSH
RDP

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of host accounts that were queried
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的主机账户总数量
